Potency of Analgesic Drugs in Mice

Source: R/data.R
Drug.Rd

Data for the comparison of the effectiveness of three analgesic drugs to a standard drug, morphine (Finney, Probit analysis, 3rd Edition 1971, p.103). 14 groups of mice were tested for response to the drugs at a range of doses.

Usage

data(Drug)

Format

A data frame with 14 rows and 5 columns:

Drug

factor, 4 drugs (Morphine, Amidone, ...).

Dose

dose (units as in Finney, 1971).

N

number of mice in the group.

R

number of mice responding.

log10Dose

log10(Dose).

Source

Finney, D. J. (1971). Probit Analysis, 3rd edition. Cambridge University Press, p. 103.

Examples

data(Drug)
gm <- glm(cbind(R, N - R) ~ Drug + log10Dose, family = binomial(link = "probit"), data = Drug)
predictmeans(gm, "Drug", covariate = c(log10Dose = 0.5))$means
